description: Given neutral \(u:\Gamma\vdash A\lor B\downarrow\) and normal verifications of \(X\land Y\) in contexts \(\Gamma,A\) and \(\Gamma,B\), the specified construction returns a normal verification of \(X\) by converting each branch to a cut-free certificate, projecting there, reconstructing its normal verification, and retaining \(u\) as the final case premise.
